newsitem.title: INDIA: India procures 9.98 mln tonnes 96/97 winter rice.
newsitem.headline: India procures 9.98 mln tonnes 96/97 winter rice.

text.p: Indian government agencies procured 9.98 million tonnes of rice from the 1996/97 (October-September) winter crop compared with 8.08 million tonnes in 1995/96, the Food Ministry said on Wednesday.
India harvests two rice crops each year, with the bulk coming from the winter crop.
The northern state of Punjab contributed 4.19 million tonnes followed by the southern state of Andhra Pradesh with 2.64 million tonnes, the ministry said in a statement.
Procurement from the northern state of Haryana until March 31, 1997 stood at 1.18 million tonnes. The statement did not give the details of procurement from the other states.
The government buys rice to build up its buffer stocks, which it then uses to control prices by releasing stocks through a state-run distribution system.
